ui.stable.title: Stable
ui.stable.lead: A horse of your own for the roads of Cyrodiil. Only you ride it, and it comes when you call it from your wheel (G) out in the open country.
ui.stable.replace_note: You keep one horse. Buying another replaces your {horse}, and nothing is paid back for it.
ui.stable.confirm: Buy the {horse} for {price} gold in place of your {owned}? Your {owned} is gone for good, and nothing is paid back for it.
ui.stable.hint: Pick a horse and buy it. Esc leaves.
